# hosttracker_contacts (Data Source)

Reads the account's contacts, narrowed by the filters below. The filters are ANDed, and each list filter matches any of its values.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every contact on the account.
data "hosttracker_contacts" "all" {}

# The text-message and voice contacts that have not confirmed their
# address yet - the ones alerts are silently not delivered to.
data "hosttracker_contacts" "unconfirmed_phones" {
  type      = ["sms", "voiceCall"]
  confirmed = false
}

# A free-text search over name and address.
data "hosttracker_contacts" "ops" {
  q           = "ops"
  max_results = 100
}

output "unconfirmed_phone_addresses" {
  value = [for c in data.hosttracker_contacts.unconfirmed_phones.contacts : c.address]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `confirmed` (Boolean) Keep only the contacts that have confirmed their address, or only the ones that have not. Unset, both are returned.
- `max_results` (Number) How many contacts to collect across pages. Defaults to 1000. The data source walks the cursor itself and stops here.
- `q` (String) Keep only contacts whose name or address contains this text, matched case-insensitively.
- `type` (Set of String) Keep only contacts of these types: `email`, `sms`, `voiceCall`, `http`, `webPush` or one of the messenger channels. An unknown type is refused rather than answered with an empty list.

### Read-Only

- `contacts` (Attributes List) The matched contacts. A listing carries no custom templates. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--contacts))
- `ids` (List of String) The matched contacts' ids, in the order the API returned them.

<a id="nestedatt--contacts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `contacts`

Read-Only:

- `active_period` (Attributes) The daily window during which the contact accepts delivery. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--contacts--active_period))
- `address` (String) Where notifications are delivered. Absent for a contact that has none, and for a token that may not read it.
- `alert_delay` (Number) How long a failure must persist before this contact hears about it, in minutes.
- `billing_notifications` (Boolean) Whether the account's billing notices go here.
- `bot_id` (String) The bot registration a messenger contact is bound to.
- `confirmed` (Boolean) Whether the recipient has entered the confirmation code. Alerts to an unconfirmed contact are not delivered.
- `created` (Number) When the contact was created, in Unix seconds.
- `gateway` (String) The gateway carrying the message.
- `grouped_alerts` (Boolean) Whether simultaneous alerts are collapsed into one message.
- `http_headers` (Attributes List) The headers a legacy `http` contact sends with each delivery. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--contacts--http_headers))
- `id` (String) The contact's id.
- `language` (String) The language notifications are rendered in.
- `mime_type` (String) The content type a legacy `http` contact is posted with.
- `name` (String) The display name.
- `overlimited` (Boolean) Whether the account's package has stopped this contact from being used.
- `send_cost` (Number) What one notification to this contact costs. Only the paid channels have one.
- `send_news` (Boolean) Whether product news goes here.
- `templates` (Attributes List) The custom per-event bodies the contact posts. Read by the single-contact data source only: a listing does not carry them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--contacts--templates))
- `type` (String) How the contact is reached.
- `updated` (Number) The contact's creation instant, in Unix seconds: no edit moves it.

<a id="nestedatt--contacts--active_period"></a>
### Nested Schema for `contacts.active_period`

Read-Only:

- `days` (Set of String) The weekdays it applies on.
- `end` (String) When it closes.
- `start` (String) When the window opens, as a clock time.
- `timezone` (String) The zone its clock times are read in.


<a id="nestedatt--contacts--http_headers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `contacts.http_headers`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) The header name.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) The header value.


<a id="nestedatt--contacts--templates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `contacts.templates`

Read-Only:

- `content` (String) The body.
- `event` (String) Which alert the body renders.
